basic_info.description: Behind the handsome Edwardian facade is a fully modern, reimagined 5BD/3.5BA home. Walk up the marble staircase and enter the light filled, open concept living area featuring soaring ceilings, gas fireplace and dramatic stone surround. Next you'll find a gorgeous Chef's kitchen w/Calcutta marble stonework center island, custom cabinetry, and high end stainless steel appliances. The dedicated dining area is adjacent to the kitchen and has two large sliding glass doors that flood the space w/natural light and open on to a large deck, creating the perfect indoor/outdoor flow - ideal for entertaining. The deck overlooks the beautifully landscaped rear garden with high design and lush mature plants. A spacious powder room completes this level. Continue on to the upper floor and you'll find three bedrooms and baths on one level, including primary suite with large walk in closet and luxe bath. There are two additional bedrooms, one with large, attached deck. Finally, the first floor level can be internally accessed from the one car garage and includes a flexible living space with either two additional bedrooms, laundry room and a full bath accessible by both bedrooms. This level would make an ideal guest suite could be used as an office and family room with direct garden access.
